rows.grounds: compound gūḍha plus sadbhāva in accusative
compound sarvajña plus tva as abstract noun
middle voice present of root jan with prefix pra

items.question: What arises when one knows the hidden true nature of that?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature causes all-knowingness.
items.inference: Knowledge of the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: The exact gender of gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
